== Usage ==

;Normal usage
* {{tld|Percentage bar|0}} → {{Percentage bar|0}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50}} → {{Percentage bar|50}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|100}} → {{Percentage bar|100}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50.5}} → {{Percentage bar|50.5}}

;With label
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|label}} → {{Percentage bar|50|label}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50{{!}}}} → {{Percentage bar|50|}}

;With color
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50{{!}}|FF0000}} → {{Percentage bar|50||FF0000}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|hex{{=}}FF0000}} → {{Percentage bar|50|hex=FF0000}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|c{{=}}red}} → {{Percentage bar|50|c=red}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50||hex{{=}}FF0000}} → {{Percentage bar|50||hex=FF0000}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50||c{{=}}red}} → {{Percentage bar|50||c=red}}

; With width
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|width{{=}}200}} → {{Percentage bar|50|width=200}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|width{{=}}25%}} → {{Percentage bar|50|width=25%}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|width{{=}}55%}} → {{Percentage bar|50|width=55%}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|width{{=}}75%}} → {{Percentage bar|50|width=75%}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50|width{{=}}100%}} → {{Percentage bar|50|width=100%}}
* {{tld|Percentage bar|50.5|width{{=}}100%}} → {{Percentage bar|50.5|width=100%}}
